summary: The proof is mathematically complete. Complementary saturation and the zero-fresh ledger give the stated missed-mass and congestion bounds; the targetwise density pooling has the correct capacities and first moments; the complete-core applications use valid affine selectors and feasible fiber masses; the weighted product-distance duality yields the asserted target loads and support decompositions; and the derived submatching, fresh KKT restart, enlarged-target pooling, endpoint margins, affine-defect estimates, and numerical constants all follow with the claimed strict inequalities. Boundary cases with empty hit sets or zero target load are either excluded by the positive global bounds or are trivial under the stated conventions.
